description: How the roles of the audio platform relate to each other: creators and artist teams publish to listeners, advertisers fund the free tier, and listening signals flow back as royalties, analytics, and campaign proof.

relationTypes.name: Commercial
relationTypes.description: Buying reach: campaign booking and audience targeting on the platform

relationTypes.name: Operational
relationTypes.description: Day-to-day publishing and delivery of audio to listeners

relationTypes.name: Financial
relationTypes.description: Royalty pools, ad revenue shares, and monetization payouts

relationTypes.name: Information
relationTypes.description: Listening signals, audience analytics, and campaign measurement

relations.name: Releases and promotes music
relations.description: Plans releases, pitches to editorial and algorithmic surfaces, and runs promotion campaigns so new tracks land in listeners' home feeds, playlists, and recommendations.

relations.name: Publishes shows and episodes
relations.description: Publishes podcast and video episodes that listeners follow and play across devices, from commute audio to on-couch video sessions.

relations.name: Feeds streaming and fandom signals
relations.description: Streams, saves, playlist adds, and follows flow into artist analytics, telling teams whether a release converted promotion into sustained audience growth.

relations.name: Funds artists through subscription royalties
relations.description: Premium subscription fees flow through the platform royalty pool to labels and artist teams in proportion to the streams their catalog earns.

relations.name: Feeds listening and engagement signals
relations.description: Plays, completion rates, and follower growth feed creator analytics, showing which episodes and formats grow the show inside the platform.

relations.name: Targets campaigns at listeners
relations.description: Books audio, video, and display campaigns against logged-in listener audiences on the ad-supported tier, reaching listeners in the moments they are already streaming.

relations.name: Funds shows through ad spend
relations.description: Campaign budgets flow to podcast and video creators through automated ad insertion and sponsorship revenue shares on monetized shows.

relations.name: Returns campaign outcomes
relations.description: Listener ad impressions, engagement, and conversion signals roll up into the measurement and brand-lift reporting buyers need to prove campaigns worked.
